_comment: CHANGELOG-1: the committed classification for scripts/gen-changelog.mjs. One entry per first-parent merge commit on main (key 'pr-<number>' for PR merges, 'c-<first 10 hex of the commit hash>' for every other merge), plus a 'tags' map that every tag reachable from HEAD MUST classify ({heading} or {ignore} + reason) before the changelog can render. Titles are the PUBLIC changelog wording; merge subjects carry internal vocabulary, so the title here is the leak gate's remedy, not a cosmetic preference. Fail-closed forward: a merge commit absent from this map fails the generator and the freshness gate until classified here (Amendment A12 standing contract: the PR that lands a merge commit appends its own line). Historical entries were classified once, at row CHANGELOG-1 (2026-09-21).
